rules.name: Suspicious outbound byte volume
rules.description: Flags flows with unusually high bytes sent by the source.
investigation_actions: Check whether the destination is approved for large data transfers.
Review recent authentication and process activity on the source host.

rules.name: Abnormally high connection rate
rules.description: Flags a source with many recent flows in the correlation window.
investigation_actions: Group flows by destination and service to confirm whether this is expected scanning.

rules.name: Port scanning pattern
rules.description: Flags a source that touches many destination ports in a short window.
investigation_actions: Confirm whether the source is an approved vulnerability scanner.
Inspect denied connections and follow-on successful sessions.

rules.name: Repeated authentication failures
rules.description: Flags telemetry that carries repeated authentication failure counts.
investigation_actions: Review account lockout and successful login events around the same time.

rules.name: Known malicious indicator match
rules.description: Flags local or cached threat-intelligence matches with meaningful confidence.
investigation_actions: Search for other flows sharing the matched indicator.
